counting_rule: Count a bounded user-facing deliverable or substantive canonical-record repair once, after its acceptance evidence exists. Checks, individual commands, generated fields and repeat verification do not count. Failed, deferred or blocked items do not count. Never label automated source-link checks as factual review.
selection: Resume an in-progress item, otherwise choose one eligible task from current registers and verified coverage gaps. Read the project KB and search existing research first. Append the selected task with a concrete output and acceptance test before working. Keep blocked fieldwork separate and move to an independent task.
publication_policy: Founder explicitly authorizes the next 500 routine UTP backlog items without further approval prompts, including existing Git/website publication after meaningful tests and review. Record actual batch scope, PR, review and deployment evidence. This does not appoint AI personas, verify facts, authorize outreach or spending, activate held commercial projects, or change unrelated repositories.
continuation: One item at a time in this chat. Work in coherent checked batches; preserve concurrent changes. Stop at 500 completed items, or on a newer human stop instruction.

items.title: Prepare an evidence-led operator readiness and bounded trial decision pack
items.acceptance: A reusable assessment distinguishes unknown, evidence-backed gaps and scope exclusions; maps six existing leads to unanswered questions; offers a trial decision template with host, participant, permission, cost and stop conditions; preserves unconfirmed states and WORK172 dependencies; bundle validation and merged documentation receipt.

items.title: Preserve keyboard position when removing and undoing planner days
items.acceptance: Empty-day removal opens and focuses available Undo; undo returns focus to the stable planner heading; cancellation keeps day and notes; restored notes persist; browser keyboard checks, regression suite, tested PR, deployment and live receipt.

items.title: Make backup previews follow the latest file and remain keyboard reachable
items.acceptance: Out-of-order file reads and errors cannot replace the newest import choice; oversized/invalid files preserve existing data; preview has a stable keyboard review target even at ten journeys; merging returns focus to planner; deterministic race tests, browser import checks, tested PR, deployment and live receipt.

items.title: Guard the autonomous completion count with linked delivery evidence
items.acceptance: A read-only CI validator rejects count drift, duplicate IDs, invalid work/authority references, unsafe or missing evidence, and completions without linked review and delivery receipts. It accepts existing shared-batch and documentation-only evidence, and does not infer factual truth or approvals. Negative fixtures, register validation, tested PR and merged tooling receipt.

items.title: Publish an illustrated maritime reading story linking remembrance, objects and inquiry
items.acceptance: A source-scoped maritime story uses existing licensed photographs, separates Boita remembrance, anchor provenance and India–Bali research, connects to existing museum and Global Connections pages, and works on wide and narrow screens with accessible citations. No speculative voyage maps, unverified ancestry or new search eligibility. Source review, browser check, tested PR, deployment and live receipt.

items.title: Repair KB entry navigation to distinguish current delivery from historical snapshots
items.acceptance: README, KB index and records index lead to authoritative current work, completed-item evidence, release records and review gaps; stale blanket search-disabled wording is dated and corrected against existing evidence; historical source records remain unchanged; local links and bundle checks pass; reviewed PR and merged documentation receipt.

items.title: Match Latin transliteration accents without erasing Odia search distinctions

Reproduce failing cases, regression tests, browser search check, tested PR, deployment and live receipt.

items.title: Share the selected Explore results instead of dropping search and filters
items.acceptance: Explore sharing retains bounded search and valid topic/area/order choices with an explicit results label. Unknown parameters and fragments stay out; other page links remain clean, including journey and contribution pages. Regression tests, browser link check, tested PR, deployment and live receipt.

items.title: Cancel superseded photo-journey audio starts
items.acceptance: A delayed audio resume cannot build sound or restart playback after stop, chapter change, page leave or a newer audio choice. Rapid toggles create only the current sound session; rejected or unavailable audio leaves photographs usable. Deterministic race tests, browser playback/stop check, tested PR, deployment and live receipt.

items.title: Let readers save and carry the maritime story with its evidence boundaries
items.acceptance: A separate Reading item saves the maritime article without adding a museum visit. Portable HTML/text retain chapter narrative, questions, source limits and photograph credit; private-note exclusion and earlier plans remain intact. Public edition includes the item without search eligibility expansion. Tests, browser check where available, tested PR, deployment and live receipt.

items.title: Prepare Boita tourism policy and entrepreneurship discussion framework
items.acceptance: A five-part desk discussion framework links existing evidence to separate governance and entrepreneurship proposals, names evidence needed before calling an obstacle observed, supplies a reusable barrier-to-recommendation record and measurable trial decision rules, and states human roles, cost boundaries and proposed requests. WORK173 and its field dependencies stay open. Checked links, factual scope review, tested PR and merged documentation receipt; no website deployment, outreach or project activation.

items.title: Reject ambiguous and malformed program authority records
items.acceptance: The read-only autonomous checker rejects duplicate or malformed work/decision registries and invalid program authority/owner or decision actors with actionable findings, never uncaught exceptions or last-record-wins lookup. Current records and shared receipts stay valid. Fault-injection and read-only tests, required PR checks, exact-head merge and tooling receipt; no website deployment required.

items.title: Prepare a Konark–Mamallapuram heritage learning proposal
items.acceptance: A sourced Konark–Mamallapuram candidate brief separates documented heritage characteristics from proposed cooperation; includes reciprocal visitor-story activity, participant roles and vacancies, outputs, staged human decisions, budget categories, benefit measures and stop conditions. Evidence records reuse Konark and global research, add only missing counterpart facts, and make no claim of partnership, outreach or current service quality. Linked KB navigation, source/scope review, repository checks and merged documentation receipt; no website deployment.

items.title: Bring the town heritage learning candidate to Global Connections
items.acceptance: Global Connections displays the sourced Konark–Mamallapuram desk candidate as a clearly proposed reciprocal activity with a licensed Konark photograph, distinct heritage facts, concrete outputs, limits and an existing Konark reading link. Existing partnership counts remain unchanged. Responsive and keyboard/no-script review, source-credit checks, full tests, exact-head PR merge, approved deployment and live verification; no search eligibility expansion or outreach.

items.acceptance: Reject contradictory delivery evidence: a supplied deployment head must match the merge, recorded workflow and approval must match the authorized publication path, supplied CI/deployment run URLs must belong to UTP, and supplied validation must pass. Preserve legacy receipt shapes and docs-only exemptions. Fault-injection and read-only tests, passing required PR check, exact-head merge and tooling delivery receipt; no website deployment required.
